title: Reopening a paid work order keeps its representatives
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: A work order with different Labor and Parts representatives was invoiced and paid in full, and is reopened.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-C} as its one sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} shows "Sales Representative - Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" {Sales-rep-B}; it has been invoiced and paid in full.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Reopen {Work-order-1}.
  2. Open the work order that reopening made and read its representative fields.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a work order is made from {Work-order-1} and can be edited.
  • Step 2: it shows "Sales Representative - Labor" reading {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" reading {Sales-rep-B}, not the customer's {Sales-rep-C}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R29: “A work order or part sale made from another one, by Split Work Order, Split Part Sale or reopening a paid work order, starts with the representatives of the one it came from: one field, or the Labor and Parts fields with the same people. It does not take the customer's.”
